decision: One feature chaining followed by one or more further ones, each after a `.`, as SysML 8.2.2.6.5 states it. A chain therefore has at least two segments by construction.
notes:
THIS IS THE SYSML VARIANT (ADR-0014). The other language states this production differently and is a separate unit, derived from its own clause and not consulted here. SysML spells the chain out where KerML refers to a FeatureChain production. The Xtext, shared from KerMLExpressions, uses KerML's factoring; it is a second opinion and the SysML clause is followed.

The two languages' bodies differ in factoring and, as far as their expansions go, accept the same text. That is recorded, not relied on: equivalence across languages is not something this unit asserts, which is why the production was split at all.

evidence.note: writes it as FeatureChain, KerML's factoring of the same shape
